add_additional_header.description: PSX-EXEs have a 0x800-byte header. The first 0x04C-bytes are used internally. Then, there is a region marker, and the rest is zero-filled. However, the BIOS nor the game do not verify or use this region marker or the zero-space, so we can treat it as additional free space. In the packed binary, the header starts at 0xDC98, and the free space starts at 0xDD20.
